This is a good start! Here are a few ways to expand on this sentence to make it even more compelling:

**Option 1 (Focus on the surprise):**

> In a shocking discovery that defied all scientific expectation, a herd of unicorns was found thriving in a remote, previously unexplored valley deep within the Andes Mountains.

This option emphasizes the unexpected nature of the find.

**Option 2 (Focus on the location):**

> Nestled within a remote, previously unexplored valley cloaked by the towering peaks of the Andes Mountains, scientists have made an unbelievable discovery: a living, breathing herd of unicorns.

This option highlights the exotic and isolated location.

**Option 3 (Focus on the rarity):**

> What was once relegated to the realm of myth and legend has become a breathtaking reality: a herd of unicorns has been discovered by scientists in a remote, untouched valley hidden high in the Andes Mountains.

This option plays up the mythical aspect and turns it into factual news.

**Option 4 (More descriptive):**

> In a discovery poised to rewrite zoology textbooks, scientists stumbled upon a herd of unicorns while exploring a remote, previously uncharted valley amidst the jagged peaks of the Andes Mountains.

This option uses stronger verbs and foreshadows the impact of the discovery.

**Which one is best depends on what you want to emphasize in your opening paragraph.**
